text: The unaudited consolidated financial results for the period ending September 30, 2018 (2018 Q3) are provided in Attachment 1. Strong performance from the marketable securities portfolios and direct investments contributed to higher-than-projected revenues, recognizing that these are 'paper gains'. Expenses are generally in line with the budget.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the report (October 31, 2018) from the Director of Finance and Operations for information.
